description: This PHP class defines a controller for saving or editing a nationality in the OrangeHRM system. It extends an abstract Vue controller and sets up a Vue component based on request attributes, specifically for editing an existing nationality or creating a new one.

classes.name: SaveNationalityController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for preparing the Vue component for saving or editing a nationality record. It determines whether an existing nationality is being edited (by checking for an 'id' attribute) and configures the appropriate Vue component accordingly.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component before rendering based on request data. Sets the component to 'nationality-edit' with an 'id' property if editing an existing nationality, or to 'nationality-save' for creating a new one.
